desc:
Welcome to Fight for Eggs! 🥚⚔️

🎮 How to Play: 

⚔️ Fight powerful animals with your sword 
🥚 Beat them and their egg cracks open 
🍀 Get lucky: bigger animals, gold, diamonds & rainbows! 
🏃 Carry your animal home before the boss catches you 
🐾 Place it in your base to earn money 
⚡ Train your speed and upgrade your swords 
🧬 Merge 3 animals into a stronger one 
🏆 Collect every animal in the Index! 

❤️ Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards! 
🔥 Can you find the rarest animal and become the richest player?
